requirement: Client authentication shall ensure that an authorised client is operating the equipment.

targets.possible_definition: An authorized user or entity that operates and interacts with the equipment.

requirement: The system shall make interoperability possible between field devices' functions and office applications.

targets.possible_definition: The capability of allowing field device functions and office applications to communicate and work together seamlessly.
Hardware components deployed in the operational environment whose functions interact with office applications.
Software programs used in business environments that interface with operations and field device functions.
Operational capabilities or processes performed by field devices.

requirement: The system shall support communication with older RTUs

targets.possible_definition: Remote Terminal Units; legacy hardware devices used to interface physical equipment with the control system.

requirement: The system shall include a SCADA-system that supports the management of multiple wind power plants

targets.possible_definition: A supervisory system that provides centralized monitoring and control across multiple wind power plants.
Facilities composed of wind turbines that generate renewable electricity and are managed by the system.

requirement: A wind farm shall include a controller for co-ordinated control of the individual wind turbines.

targets.possible_definition: A collection of individual wind turbines managed together under coordinated control.
Individual power-generating units within a wind farm whose operation is centrally coordinated.

requirement: A wind farm controller shall support transmission on demand.

targets.possible_definition: An array of wind turbines equipped with a central controller for power transmission.
A capability enabling the wind farm controller to transmit power or data immediately upon request.

requirement: The network shall operate on TCP/IP standards and procedures

targets.possible_definition: Standard communications protocols and procedures governing data transmission across the network.

requirement: The analogue signals from the wind turbines shall be available for display on operator HMI as well as storage databases.

targets.possible_definition: Human-Machine Interface; a display interface used by operators to view turbine real-time signals.
Continuous data signals generated by wind turbines that are routed to database storage and operator displays.
Rotary devices that output analogue signals reflecting their operational status.
